en: Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
zh: 修复不含 `"$defaults"` 的托管 `autoMode.allow` 列表会通过宿主应用的 `--settings`、在 `/permissions` 中添加的第一条规则或 `/auto-mode-setup` 重新获得内置例外的问题
